VB-CABLE is donationware. All contributions are welcome.
Support / license: https://shop.vb-audio.com/en/win-apps/11-vb-cable.html
Distribution terms: https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm

KeepQuiet includes the original, unmodified base VB-CABLE package:
VBCABLE_Driver_Pack46.zip
SHA256 bc44e8974191a5a2427d6c979e2dab08dbb09925f3f435dfa2f0ba3e45b6eb90
Downloaded from the official HTTPS download on 2026-11-14.

The public "VB-CABLE Distribution with another product" terms allow
bundling the original base package and silent deployment while preserving
the donationware model, attribution and opportunity to support VB-Audio.
Professional/organizational deployments have additional licensing conditions.
Additional cables A+B and C+D are not included.

The original ZIP, including its readme/license and signed binaries, is embedded
unchanged in KeepQuiet. Its older readme text and the publisher's current public
distribution terms are retained by reference; no ownership of the driver is claimed.
Driver installation still needs Windows administrator consent and a restart.
